rationale: Surge rose 1.0x -> 1.4x and the notice ("Fares are 1.4× higher right now. Your fare stays at the quoted $12.71. You can cancel for free.") did not state the revised fare: not notified under SURGE-1 -> refund the surge differential (SURGE-2). Differential = (1.4 − 1.0) × surgeable subtotal $10.66 = $4.26; the booking fee is not surged (SURGE-3). The fare is only $3.46 above the quote (the trip ran shorter than the estimate), so the refund is capped at $3.46.
